item.description:
Kipowi 0.8.4

  • Choose the bit depth when exporting WAV or AIFF: the source's, 24, 16 or 8. Eight is the lo-fi one — a quarter of the size of 32-bit float and audibly grainy.
  • Cut out now works properly on an audio file. The waveform is redrawn for the clip that is left, level moves follow the sound rather than staying where they were, and the exported file is the cut version — it used to be written from the uncut original.
  • A movie's soundtrack gets the same rate and channel settings as an audio export. Kipowi used to write every movie as stereo at 48 kHz whatever went in; now Source means the source, and a change is stated before you commit to it.
  • The export panel is grouped into File, Picture and Sound instead of one long list of rows, and the size estimate is set apart from everything above it.
